items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: I’m reading this book about the life of Mozart

ctx.x: I listen to — right now I’m delving into Sir Edward Elgar right now, all of his oratorios, his symphonies, his orchestral works, his concertos. His oratorios, his choral works are incredible. And at the moment I’m reading this book about the life of Mozart, which is written by Madard Sullivan, which is a tremendous undertaking. I mean the book is this thick of tiny small print, which at the age of 60 I find I can still read without assistance, I’m lucky that way.
